Treinei um modelo com vídeos do AV-FFIA: I trained a model on AV-FFIA videos to classify fish feeding activity. FeedWatch analyzes recordings in two-second windows and combines the results into a video summary.
O objetivo é avaliar ajustes no fornecim: The aim is to assess feeding adjustments that could reduce waste. Any savings still need to be measured in feeding trials.

O panorama soma o tempo classificado em: The overview adds up the time classified at each level. A video-wide predominant level requires at least 80% of the duration to be classified. To compare the start, middle and end, the video is divided into three equal parts. Each part needs at least 4 seconds, two results and 80% classified time. A level predominates only if it occupies more than half of the classified time. These rules determine whether the comparison can be displayed; they have not been validated as feeding-management indicators.
O modelo classifica a atividade alimenta: The model classifies feeding activity into four levels. Classification is an estimate from the images; it does not measure fish hunger or the amount of feed needed.
Sem sinais de atividade alimentar reconh: No signs of feeding activity recognized by the model.
Pouca atividade alimentar estimada no pe: Low estimated feeding activity in this window.
Atividade alimentar estimada em nível in: Estimated feeding activity at an intermediate level.
Atividade alimentar estimada como intens: Estimated feeding activity at a high level.
O resultado aparece ao fim de cada perío: A result appears at the end of each 2-second window, so the displayed level can change during playback. Any remaining segment shorter than 2 seconds at the end of the video is left unclassified.
Os retângulos indicam onde o detector en: Rectangles show where the detector found fish. Lines show their movement, and numbers help track them while they remain visible. A fish may receive a different number when it reappears. These annotations do not confirm that it is eating.

Para treinar o modelo, usei parte do: To train the model, I used part of
AV-FFIA, de Meng Cui e colaboradores: AV-FFIA, by Meng Cui and colleagues
. O conjunto contém vídeos classificados: . The dataset contains videos labeled by feeding intensity with guidance from a technician. The U-FFIA study uses these data to investigate feeding activity recognition.
A cada 2 segundos, uma MobileNetV3 Small: Every 2 seconds, a pretrained MobileNetV3 Small extracts features from 16 frames. Its weights remain fixed. The GRU trained in this project receives those features and classifies feeding activity. Two Fishial detectors locate fish, and a tracker follows their movement. Fish detection and feeding classification are separate analyses.

O menor acerto foi na categoria moderada: Accuracy was lowest for the moderate category. Evaluation with other cameras, species and environments is still needed. The completed tests cannot determine feed quantities, demonstrate savings or estimate a tank's fish population.
A avaliação histórica utiliza 7.104 clip: The historical evaluation uses 7,104 clips split by recording day: 3,898 for training, 1,705 for validation and 1,501 for testing. Test clips were recorded on June 22, 2022.
Acurácia é o percentual de classificaçõe: Accuracy is the percentage of correct classifications. Macro-F1 measures performance with equal weight for the four categories; values closer to 1 are better. The last column shows the percentage of moderate-category clips recognized correctly, called recall in the reports.
Também testei um retreinamento com maior: I also tested retraining with greater weight for the moderate category. It did not meet the criteria for replacing the operational model. The 224 clips were selected before running the models, and evaluation used the dataset's published labels. Because the clips come from the same recording context and may resemble one another, this result does not establish performance on other farms.

Testei três configurações com maior regu: I tested three configurations with stronger regularization to reduce memorization of the training videos. Each configuration was trained three times with different initializations, for nine training runs in total. Comparison used training and validation data.
Nenhuma configuração atingiu os critério: No configuration met the criteria for replacing the operational model. The days reserved for the next test remain separate and were not used in this selection.
